query: I have invested in a company using CPF. How can I get the latest financial statement or annual report of this company, if the company has been delisted? And what should I do if the company does not respond to my request?
reference_answer: You may approach the company for the financial statement or annual report directly. You can mail your request to their office address through registered post. The office addresses of companies can be found onACRA's BizFile portal. If you do not hear back from the company, please approach your agent bank who will follow up with ACRA.

answer: If the company is delisted, contact all stockbrokers to inform them of your new CPF Investment Account number. If they don't respond, consider contacting the CPF Board directly for assistance. [Document 1] For non-responsive companies, you might face restrictions or need to switch funds, as per [Document 2]. Always check the CPF Board's policies for recovering premature withdrawals or penalties. [Document 3] Lastly, if payments are delayed, check your CPF account balance within 3-5 working days.
